overview: The Medford School Committee convened and voted to enter executive session to address collective bargaining, potential litigation, and contract negotiations with non-union personnel, opting not to reconvene in public session.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Roll Call
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn called the 11th regular meeting of the Medford School Committee to order and established a quorum.

items.title: Vote to Enter Executive Session
items.summary: The Committee approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining with the Massachusetts Teachers Association, potential litigation strategy, and contract negotiations with non-union personnel.
